character: A single-hotel mountain resort on the northern edge of the Myoko area in Niigata, formerly marketed as Lotte Arai Resort and now as Arai Mountain Resort. It receives very heavy snowfall and is known for steep terrain, tree runs and designated freeride zones.
learning: Reference, confirm: the terrain leans toward intermediate and advanced skiers (steep slopes, tree runs, freeride zones per the search summary); ski school and rentals operate at the hotel.

source.note: Yukiguni Journey 2025-2026: "Operating Period: December 13 (Saturday) to May 10, 2026 (Sunday)" — published operating period; actual days may have differed.
